entry.en: A Cameroon passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after the arrival date.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe caducar al menos 6 meses después de la fecha de llegada a Camerún.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: Visas cannot be obtained on arrival at Yaoundé or Douala airport.
entry.es: No se puede obtener visado a la llegada en los aeropuertos de Yaundé ni Duala.
entry.quote: You cannot get a visa on arrival at either Yaoundé or Douala airport.

entry.en: Travellers arriving by road or sea must get a physical visa beforehand, as e-visas are not available at land or sea borders.
entry.es: Quienes lleguen por tierra o mar deben obtener antes un visado físico, pues no hay e-visa en fronteras terrestres ni marítimas.
entry.quote: If you travel to Cameroon by road or sea, you must get a physical visa before you arrive by applying at your nearest Cameroon embassy or high commission.

entry.en: A certificate proving yellow fever vaccination is required to enter Cameroon.
entry.es: Se exige un certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla para entrar en Camerún.
entry.quote: To enter Cameroon, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination.

entry.en: Travellers should make sure the border officer stamps their passport.
entry.es: Los viajeros deben asegurarse de que el agente fronterizo selle su pasaporte.
entry.quote: Make sure the border control officer puts a stamp in your passport.

safety.en: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Cameroon, which could be indiscriminate.
safety.es: Es muy probable que los terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Camerún, que podrían ser indiscriminados.
safety.quote: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Cameroon.

safety.en: The FCDO advises against all travel to the North-West Region.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a la región Noroeste.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to the North-West Region.

safety.en: The FCDO advises against all travel to within 40km of the border with Central African Republic.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a menos de 40 km de la frontera con la República Centroafricana.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to within 40km of the border with Central African Republic (CAR).

safety.en: There is a risk of armed robbery and mugging throughout Cameroon, particularly in Yaoundé, Douala, Ngaoundere and Bafoussam.
safety.es: Hay riesgo de robo a mano armada y atracos en todo Camerún, sobre todo en Yaundé, Duala, Ngaoundéré y Bafoussam.
safety.quote: There is risk of armed robbery and mugging throughout Cameroon, particularly in the cities Yaoundé, Douala, Ngaoundere and Bafoussam.

safety.en: Hailing taxis from the roadside is not advised; only trusted, pre-arranged taxis should be used.
safety.es: No se aconseja parar taxis en la calle; solo deben usarse taxis de confianza reservados con antelación.
safety.quote: Do not hail taxis from the roadside (these are yellow in Yaoundé and Douala). Only use trusted, pre-arranged taxis

safety.en: Same-sex sexual acts are illegal in Cameroon and same-sex partners have been arrested and prosecuted.
safety.es: Los actos sexuales entre personas del mismo sexo son ilegales en Camerún y se ha detenido y procesado a parejas.
safety.quote: same-sex sexual acts are illegal in Cameroon. Same-sex partners have been arrested and prosecuted.

health.en: Medical facilities in Cameroon are below UK standards and emergency facilities are extremely limited.
health.es: Los centros médicos de Camerún están por debajo de los estándares del Reino Unido y las urgencias son muy limitadas.
health.quote: Medical facilities in Cameroon are below UK standards. Emergency facilities are extremely limited.

health.en: Serious medical treatment may require medical evacuation to Europe, so adequate travel health insurance is needed.
health.es: Un tratamiento médico grave puede requerir evacuación a Europa, por lo que hace falta un seguro médico de viaje adecuado.
health.quote: For serious medical treatment, medical evacuation to Europe will be necessary.

health.en: Health risks in Cameroon include Zika, malaria, dengue, yellow fever and cholera.
health.es: Los riesgos sanitarios en Camerún incluyen zika, malaria, dengue, fiebre amarilla y cólera.
health.quote: See what health risks you’ll face in Cameroon, including:

health.en: Wikivoyage advises avoiding tap water, even in restaurants, and sticking to bottled water.
health.es: Wikivoyage aconseja evitar el agua del grifo, incluso en restaurantes, y beber solo agua embotellada.
health.quote: Avoid drinking tap water, even in restaurants. Only stick to bottled water.

health.en: Malaria is prevalent, and insect repellent and a mosquito net are suggested.
health.es: La malaria es frecuente y se sugiere usar repelente de insectos y mosquitero.
health.quote: Malaria is prevalent. To lower your chances of contracting malaria, regularly use insect repellent and consider draping a mosquito net over your bed.

help.en: In Cameroon the emergency numbers are 112 for ambulance, 119 for fire and 117 for police.
help.es: En Camerún los números de emergencia son el 112 para ambulancia, el 119 para bomberos y el 117 para policía.

getting_in.en: The international airports are Douala International Airport and Yaoundé Nsimalen International Airport.
getting_in.es: Los aeropuertos internacionales son el de Duala y el internacional de Yaundé Nsimalen.
getting_in.quote: International airports are Douala International Airport (DLA IATA) and Yaoundé Nsimalen International Airport (NSI IATA)

getting_in.en: Airport staff or hangers-on sometimes try to help with luggage and ask for around FCFA 1,000.
getting_in.es: A veces el personal del aeropuerto u otras personas ayudan con el equipaje y piden unos 1.000 FCFA.
getting_in.quote: Sometimes airport staff, or just hangers on, try to help with the luggage in order to get extra euros/dollars from travellers. They'll ask for around FCFA 1,000.

getting_in.en: Most travelers need a visa, as there are few visa-free arrangements.
getting_in.es: La mayoría de viajeros necesita visado, pues hay pocos acuerdos de exención.
getting_in.quote: There are few visa-free arrangements in place, so most travelers need a visa.

getting_around.en: Camrail trains run from Yaoundé to Douala and to Ngaoundéré, and the overnight train is the best ground transport to the north.
getting_around.es: Los trenes de Camrail van de Yaundé a Duala y a Ngaoundéré, y el tren nocturno es el mejor transporte terrestre al norte.
getting_around.quote: the overnight train is the best mode of ground transport to the north.

getting_around.en: Buses rarely leave at a set time; they wait until they are full.
getting_around.es: Los autobuses rara vez salen a una hora fija; esperan a llenarse.
getting_around.quote: Buses rarely leave at a set time. Instead, they wait until they are full and then depart.

getting_around.en: Away from larger centres you will most likely end up on bush taxis, with safety a concern.
getting_around.es: Fuera de las grandes ciudades lo más probable es usar taxis colectivos rurales, con la seguridad como preocupación.
getting_around.quote: Away from the larger centres you will most likely end up on the ever present Toyota bush taxis.

getting_around.en: A 4x4 is described as a necessity for travelling to the east or central areas.
getting_around.es: Se describe un 4x4 como necesario para viajar al este o centro del país.
getting_around.quote: a 4 x 4 is a necessity when travelling to the east or central areas of Cameroon.

getting_around.en: Driving standards are poor and roads are generally in poor condition.
getting_around.es: El nivel de conducción es deficiente y las carreteras suelen estar en mal estado.
getting_around.quote: Driving standards are poor in Cameroon.

getting_around.en: Travel at night should be avoided, particularly in rural areas.
getting_around.es: Se debe evitar viajar de noche, sobre todo en zonas rurales.
getting_around.quote: Avoid travelling at night in Cameroon, particularly in rural areas.

money.en: The currency is the Central African CFA franc (FCFA, XAF).
money.es: La moneda es el franco CFA centroafricano (FCFA, XAF).
money.quote: The currency of the country is the Central African CFA franc, denoted FCFA (ISO currency code: XAF).

money.en: Euros and US dollars are the most widely accepted foreign currencies.
money.es: Los euros y los dólares estadounidenses son las divisas extranjeras más aceptadas.
money.quote: Euros and US dollars are the most widely accepted foreign currency.

money.en: ATMs are not often available outside of large towns.
money.es: Los cajeros no abundan fuera de las grandes ciudades.
money.quote: ATMs are not often available outside of large towns.

money.en: Shops usually require small notes, which can be difficult to obtain.
money.es: Las tiendas suelen exigir billetes pequeños, que pueden ser difíciles de conseguir.
money.quote: Shops usually require small notes, which can be difficult to obtain.

money.en: Outside stores and restaurants you must bargain for everything, demanding 20-50% of the first price.
money.es: Fuera de tiendas y restaurantes hay que regatear todo, pidiendo el 20-50% del primer precio.
money.quote: Unless you are in stores and restaurants, you must bargain for everything. Demand 20-50% of the first price requested.

etiquette.en: Always greet and acknowledge people; not doing so is considered extremely rude.
etiquette.es: Conviene saludar y reconocer siempre a la gente; no hacerlo se considera extremadamente grosero.
etiquette.quote: Always make it a point to greet and acknowledge people wherever you go; not doing so is considered extremely rude.

etiquette.en: Use the right hand for shaking hands and handing things over, since the left hand is considered unclean.
etiquette.es: Se usa la mano derecha para saludar y dar cosas, pues la izquierda se considera impura.
etiquette.quote: Always use your right hand when shaking hands, bringing something to someone, and so on. The left hand is considered unclean in Cameroon.

etiquette.en: Respect for elders is very important, such as greeting the oldest person first at a home.
etiquette.es: El respeto a los mayores es muy importante, por ejemplo saludando primero a la persona de más edad en una casa.
etiquette.quote: When visiting a Cameroonian home, it is customary to greet the oldest person first.

etiquette.en: Guests invited to a home should not show up empty-handed.
etiquette.es: Quien sea invitado a una casa no debe presentarse con las manos vacías.
etiquette.quote: If you've been invited to a Cameroonian home, do not show up empty-handed.

etiquette.en: The Anglophone War and Ambazonia are highly divisive and controversial subjects.
etiquette.es: La guerra anglófona y Ambazonia son temas muy divisivos y controvertidos.
etiquette.quote: The Anglophone War, treatment of Anglophone Cameroonians, and Ambazonia are highly divisive and controversial subjects.

connectivity.en: A pre-paid SIM card is needed to make local and international calls.
connectivity.es: Se necesita una tarjeta SIM de prepago para llamadas locales e internacionales.
connectivity.quote: To make local and international calls you need to buy a pre-paid SIM card.

connectivity.en: MTN and Orange are the two major telephone companies.
connectivity.es: MTN y Orange son las dos grandes compañías telefónicas.
connectivity.quote: "MTN" and "Orange" are two major telephone companies in Cameroon.

connectivity.en: E-SIMs for data are available from companies such as Airalo and Ubigi.
connectivity.es: Hay eSIM de datos de empresas como Airalo y Ubigi.
connectivity.quote: E-SIMs are available for data connections from various companies such as Airalo and Ubigi.

connectivity.en: Local networks offer 4G connections that are neither fast nor stable.
connectivity.es: Las redes locales ofrecen 4G que no es ni rápido ni estable.
connectivity.quote: The local networks offer 4G connections which are neither fast or stable.
